Accessibility

Here are a few ways to control your experience on the Sunboy Blinds website.

  • Use the “Pause motion” button at the lower right of the hero to stop both the background film and the rotating sun rays.
  • If your device is set to reduce motion, the background film and sun rays start paused. You can choose “Play motion” to enable them.
  • Use Tab to move between links and buttons, and Enter or Space to activate a button. Press Escape to close dialogs.

The film shows window shades in a kitchen, living room and dining room. It has no sound.
